decisions.reason: Premium support sits squarely on the firm's core competence of round-the-clock expert service for agencies, so the firm can readily interpret customer feedback and refine it, making retention likely.

The version management tool extends the firm's own tool suite (security center, recovery manager), which its in-house development team understands well and can keep improving to reduce customers' recurring work.

A legal-contract generator for data processing is distant from the firm's hosting and technical knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to assimilate feedback and develop it further, and the resources are better redirected to the core platform.
Scalable agency hosting is the strategic flagship, built directly on owned data center capacity and hosting expertise, so the firm is best positioned to learn from its results and keep developing it.
